en: Black‑and‑white postcard image showing women working in a vineyard in traditional rural clothing, bent over the vines with baskets and jugs beside them. In the distant background, across the vineyard and above a line of townhouses, stands a large Gothic cathedral with twin towers and spires on a hill, next to an extensive monastery or palace‑like complex. The sky area above the cathedral is partly overpainted or damaged, leaving a white blotch.
